# Pascal Staud

> Brand and marketing consultant. Advises owners and brands in automotive and mobility, luxury and direct-to-consumer, tech and digital startups, and health. Based in Germany, working internationally.

Pascal Staud has twenty years of experience from three perspectives: the agency (managing director and partner of STAUD STUDIOS, 2009 to 2021; co-founder of Monks, 2021 to 2025), the founder (building companies from the inside), and the consultant (Pascal Staud Consulting, since 2026). Selected brands: BMW, Mercedes-AMG, Aston Martin, Infiniti, Richard Mille.

What he works on: putting the brand first, wiring marketing into revenue, and using AI to rebuild how a company meets its customers and runs.
